sources.title: GitHub - chrisipanaque/qwen-lora-finetune: Fine-tune Qwen2.5-Coder for ...
sources.snippet: This project fine-tunes Qwen2.5-Coder-1.5B on your own instruction-response pairs using QLoRA (4-bit quantization + Low-Rank Adaptation). The output is a ~16 MB LoRA adapter that captures your specific code style — shareable, swappable, and applied on top of the base model at inference time.
